contract.task_clause:
Suppose that the Durbin Watson test is applied to a regression containing two explanatory variables plus a constant with 50 data points. The test statistic takes a value of 1.53. What is the appropriate conclusion?
Option A: Residuals appear to be positively autocorrelated
Option B: Residuals appear to be negatively autocorrelated
Option C: Residuals appear not to be autocorrelated
Option D: The test result is inconclusive
